paper_title: Resonant detection of axion mediated forces with Nuclear Magnetic Resonance
suggested_experiment_name: NMR axion-mediated force search (Arvanitaki-Geraci) - existing bounds
notes: Proposal/projection paper for resonant NMR detection of axion-mediated monopole-dipole (g_sN*g_pN) and dipole-dipole spin-dependent forces using hyperpolarized 3He. The main monopole-dipole reach (Fig. 2) plots |g_sN g_pN| vs force range/fa. This is the MonopoleDipole coupling. However, data is presented only graphically (Figs. 2 and 3) with no numerical table of points, so no reliable (mass, coupling) pairs could be extracted. Force range 0.01-10 cm maps to axion masses ~10^-6 to 10^-3 eV. The paper also discusses dipole-dipole (AxionNeutron/AxionElectron) projections and a dark photon kinetic mixing reach (~10^-12 at mm range). | Vision: Figure 2 monopole-dipole plot. X-axis 'Force Range in cm' converted to axion mass via m_a = 1.973e-5 eV·cm / lambda[cm]. Top x-axis shows f_a in GeV (1e9-1e12). The lower boundary traced is the lower edge of the combined 'Astrophysical and Experimental Bounds' shaded region (existing constraints). Y-axis is |g_s^N g_p^N| (monopole-dipole product).
